info.accent: Reserved for the call to action. Using it anywhere else costs the button its pull.
info.commerce_facts: These appear in the top bar, in the fold and in the terms page. Change them here so they cannot drift apart.
info.featured_product: Leave empty on the product template to use the current product. Required on the homepage.
info.fold_heading: Leave empty to use the product title.
info.fonts_selfhosted: Instrument Serif and Instrument Sans are self-hosted in the theme assets. They are part of the brand, so they are not merchant-selectable.
info.footer_menu: Link the terms, complaints procedure, privacy policy and shipping pages here.
info.highlighted: Exactly one card should be highlighted. It uses a frame and a warm tone, never the accent colour.
info.legal_notice: Shown in a highlighted box above the page content.
info.open_by_default: Open the two most common concerns; leave the rest closed.
info.operator: Company name, registration number, address and contact e-mail. Legally required.
info.review_count: Connect this to a product metafield with the dynamic source button, or type a number. Use an Integer metafield.
info.review_rating: Connect this to a product metafield with the dynamic source button, or type a number. A Decimal metafield is the most reliable type.
info.reviews_guard: The rating block only appears when the count is at least 5 and the rating at least 4.0. Below that it is hidden entirely.
info.show_cookie_preferences: Opens Shopify's own cookie preferences dialog. The link stays hidden unless the consent API is available.
info.show_description: Pulled from the product's own description field in admin. Sits below the buy button so it never pushes the price or button out of the first screen.
info.show_topbar: Carries the shipping and returns line set under Commerce facts.
info.surface_alt: Use at most twice per page.
